t.label: Seen
t.note: When the page saw this version of the row (the host's clock).

health.label: Health
health.note: A shape and a word for warn, unknown, stale and error; empty for OK and for nothing reported.

message.label: Message
message.note: The row's own report: a black box speaks for itself; a pure group shows what is worst below it.

below.label: Below
below.note: Something below this row is worse than its own report (the host's hint).

presence.label: Presence
presence.note: Neutral, never a level: heard, last heard …, streaming.

link.label: Link
link.note: A USB device's own version (USB 2.1); the raw speed is the host's.

rate.label: Rate
rate.note: Records per second received against what the row promised; a note, never a colour.

rank.label: Rank
rank.note: ok 0 < warn 1 < unknown 2 < stale 3 < error 4; -1 when nothing reports (sorting worst first).

path.label: Path
path.note: The entity key: /-separated, rooted at host; it changes when a device moves to another port.

knock_on.label: Knock-on of
knock_on.note: This row's problem is explained by another row (subdued, not counted).

claimed.label: Claimed
claimed.note: Some driver plugin claims the row (an unclaimed keyboard or mouse stays hidden unless it reports a problem).
